'''Ballon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]], who lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Ballon worked as an arms dealer on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byrsym]], and had dealings with the resistance fighter [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Torrin]]. After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attacked the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]], a group of individuals left the world to try and locate Torrin. The individuals found Ballon in the bar [[Emthuul's]] with his employees [[Sskal]] and [[Tarula]], and they asked Ballon to contact Torrin, to see if the prince would be willing to speak to them. However, Ballon was arrested by the Galactic Empire shortly afterwards, and under interrogation the Toydarian gave the Imperials information on how to find Torrin.
